name: Codorniz (Spain)
description: Quartered by a yellow cross, white at the upper hoist, red at the upper fly and lower hoist and white at the lower fly, charged at the crossing with the crowned municipal arms of Codorniz (quails and the letters AR on white and red).
history: Municipal flag of Codorniz; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Codorniz arms — quails and the letters AR on white and red
